chapter.heading: For the music director. A psalm of David.
chapter.v:
God, the
one I praise, please don't remain silent,

because wicked
and deceitful people are attacking me, telling lies about me.

They surround
me with words of hate, fighting against me for no reason.

I love
them, but they respond with hostility towards me, even while I'm praying for them!

They pay
me back with evil instead of good, with hatred instead of love.

“Appoint someone
wicked over him. Have someone stand as an accuser against him.

When he
is judged and sentenced, may he be found guilty. Let his prayers be counted as sins.

May his
life be short; let someone else take over his position.

May his
children be left fatherless, and his wife become a widow.

May his
children be homeless, wandering beggars, driven from their ruined houses.

May creditors
seize all that he owns; may strangers take all that he worked for.

May no
one be kind to him; may no one take pity on his fatherless children.

May his
descendants die; may his family name be wiped out in the next generation.

May the
Lord be reminded of the sins of his fathers; may his mother's sins not be blotted out.

May their
sins be constantly before the Lord; may his name be totally forgotten by people.

For he
didn't think to be kind to others, instead he harassed and killed the poor, the needy, the brokenhearted.

He loved
to put a curse on others—let it come back on him. He had no time for blessings—so may he never receive any.

He cursed
as often as he got dressed. May his curses go into him like the water he drinks, like the olive oil he rubs on his skin that enters his bones.

May his
curses stick to him like clothing, may they be pulled tight around him like a belt.”

May all
this be the punishment of the Lord on my enemies, on those who speak evil of me.

But treat
me well, Lord God, because of your own reputation. Save me because you are faithful and good.

For I
am poor and needy, and my heart is breaking.

I am
fading away like an evening shadow; I am like a locust that is shaken off.

I am
so weak from lack of food that my legs give way; my body is just skin and bones.

People ridicule
me—they look at me and shake their heads!

Help me,
Lord my God; save me because of your trustworthy love.

May they
recognize that this is what you are doing—that you are the one who saves me.

When they
curse me, you will bless me. When they attack me, you will defeat them. And I, your servant, will be happy.

May those
who accuse me be clothed with disgrace; may they cover themselves with a cloak of shame.

But I
will keep on thanking the Lord, praising him to everyone around me.

For he
takes a stand to defend the needy, to save them from those who condemn them.
